description: This script generates a test suite from NIST PKITS test descriptions, producing C++ test code for GoogleTest framework. It parses test descriptions from a PDF converted to text, and outputs test case definitions with specific policies and validation expectations.

classes.name: TestSections
classes.description: Holds parsed sections of a test description including description, procedure, expected result, and certification path lines.

classes.name: TestInfo
classes.description: Describes the input parameters and expected validation outcome for a test case, including policies and flags.

methods.name: sanitize_name
methods.description: Removes spaces and hyphens from a string to create a sanitized test name.

methods.name: finalize_test_case
methods.description: Writes the registration of a test case with its sanitized test names into the output.

methods.name: bool_to_str
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 'true' or 'false' string.

methods.name: make_policies_string
methods.description: Joins a list of policies into a comma-separated string enclosed in quotes.

methods.name: output_test
methods.description: Generates a test case code snippet with specific parameters and appends it to the output.

methods.name: parse_main_test_sections
methods.description: Extracts description, procedure, expected result, and certification path lines from the test description lines.

methods.name: parse_cert_path_lines
methods.description: Parses certification path lines to extract certificate and CRL names.

methods.name: parse_test
methods.description: Parses individual test descriptions, applies overrides, and outputs test case code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads the PDF, converts to text, extracts test descriptions, and generates the test code file.
